    Established in 1983 by Prof. (Dr.) S. B. Mujumdar, Founder and
    President of Symbiosis, Symbiosis Schools have grown into a trusted
    name in education.

    Under the leadership of Dr. Vidya Yeravdekar, Principal Director of Symbiosis and Chancellor, Symbiosis International (Deemed University), the schools continue to be identified with strong academic standards and exceptional learning outcomes.

    Under the Symbiosis Society, there are nine schools affiliated with different boards. Symbiosis World School at Lavale, Mulshi, Pune is affiliated to both International Baccalaureate (IB) and Cambridge International Education curriculum; while Symbiosis International School at Vimannagar, Pune follows International Baccalaureate (IB) curriculum. Symbiosis Primary School and Symbiosis Secondary School at Prabhat Road, Pune (English medium) and Symbiosis School at Harali (Marathi medium) follow the State Board curriculum. Symbiosis School in Nashik is an English medium school affiliated with CBSE. Additionally, Symbiosis Open School, offers both English and Marathi mediums, and is affiliated with the National Institute of Open Schooling (NIOS).

    Symbiosis also takes pride in its Kindergarten Schools. Symbi Stars at Model Colony is a standalone preschool, while the Early Years Programme (EYP) runs at the Symbiosis International School. Apart from this, Symbiosis Kindergarten, Nashik has set a benchmark in early childhood education. These schools offer a combination of formal and informal learning through its child-centric, play-based approach that nurtures curiosity, creativity and confidence.

    Symbiosis International (Deemed University)

    Symbiosis International (Deemed University) is a multi-disciplinary university offering its students and faculty a vibrant learning ecosystem designed around its multi-cultural and innovative ethos. In recognition of its academic excellence, the MHRD, Government of India, has conferred on Symbiosis the 'Deemed to be University' status, in 2002.

    Initially conceived as a heaven for foreign students studying in India, Symbiosis has grown into a multifaceted institution rooted in the Vedic principle of "Vasudhaiva Kutumbakam" – the world is one family. This philosophy resonates deeply with the university's mission of fostering international understanding through quality education.

    The university attracts students from all Indian states and international students from over 85+ countries. The university's qualified and dedicated faculty are committed to disseminating knowledge and transforming students into qualified, skilled, and responsible global citizens. SIU's strong academic reputation has led to its selection as a participating institution in the Government of India's "Study in India" Program.

    SIU consistently ranks among top Indian universities in national (NIRF) and international (THE, QS) rankings. It boasts strong employer reputation and excels in fields like Business and Management and Social Sciences. Beyond academics, SIU has received prestigious accolades like the 2000-Watt Smart City recognition and the Asia Pacific Quality Label (APQL).

    --

    The University cultivates a dynamic research environment. Supported by government and industry, its faculty and Ph.D. students actively engage in research across diverse fields, including AI, medical imaging, and sustainability. Equipped with state-of-the-art labs and fostering international collaborations, SIU encourages innovation and entrepreneurship through initiatives like the Symbiosis Centre of Entrepreneurship and Innovation (SCEI).

    In line with its commitment to Institutional Social Responsibility, SIU operates the Symbiosis Community Outreach Programme and Extension (SCOPE) Centre, which has adopted 35 villages to provide healthcare, sanitation, waste management, finance and banking, digital literacy, legal counselling, and scholarships. Family doctor clinics, mobile medical units, and mobile digital literacy vans cater to several villages around the university campus.

    --

    As a Health Promoting University, the University has established the Symbiosis Medical College for Women (SMCW) and the Symbiosis University and Hospital Research Centre (SUHRC) and centers like the Symbiosis Centre for Emotional Wellbeing (SCEW).

    With its diverse programs, world-class faculty, and commitment to research and community engagement, the University
    continues to shape the lives of students and contribute to the betterment of society.
